actions.name: curve left on black (left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %)
curve right on no black (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %)

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 30, look for a left or right obstacle and curve away, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the front obstacle sensor sees something, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel without hitting its walls, turning away from a wall on either side.
